title: SatCompute ComputeProfile 0.1
description: Closed-world static compute-capacity input for one SatCompute constellation.

schema_version.description: ComputeProfile contract version; version 0.1 is required by this schema.

compute_nodes.description: Non-empty set of compute-capable satellites; array order has no semantic effect.

compute_node.description: One stable satellite ID and its constant work-service rate.

node_id.description: Unique external uint32 satellite ID on which the compute service runs.

compute_rate_work_units_per_second.description: Positive uint64 service rate in abstract compute work units per simulation second.
